reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Since you’ve completed the referral theory and e-learning, the *Open Water Referral Course* sounds like the right option. One important note: the referral course requires your referral paperwork to be *signed by a PADI instructor*.

The refresher is booked as a Dive Mini Course. It’s a one-day review with pool practice and one ocean dive, and it does *not* count toward your Open Water certification. The two-day referral course requires at least one overnight stay on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

*Open Water referral course*, depending on where you start from (online price per person):
• *From Cartagena*: 474 USD, round-trip boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita; lunch included.
• *Already on the islands*: 432 USD, pickup at your hotel if it has sea access; no lunch.

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊
